mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, people_id, biz_date, clip_code, watched, is_deleted, gmt_created, gmt_modified, gmt_deleted FROM science_daily WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND biz_date = #{bizDate} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT clip_code, MIN(biz_date) AS first_biz_date FROM science_daily WHERE people_id = #{peopleId} AND watched = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY clip_code
